title: Medical Cannabis | BUZZY
description: What BUZZY says about medical cards and adult-use shopping, with a pointer to the state medical cannabis program.
lede: BUZZY is an adult-use dispensary. Here is what BUZZY says about medical cards, in its own words.

blocks.html: Cannabis is legal in New York for medical use and for adult use.
blocks.sourceTitle: Is Cannabis Legal in New York? A 2026 Guide to the Rules

sections.heading: Do I need a medical card to shop at BUZZY?

blocks.html: No. BUZZY is an adult-use cannabis dispensary for customers 21+.

If you are 21 or older, you do not need to be enrolled in New York’s Medical Cannabis Program to shop at an adult-use dispensary. Medical cannabis operates as a separate program with different patient requirements.
blocks.sourceTitle: What Do You Need to Buy Weed in Brooklyn? ID, Age & Dispensary Basics

blocks.html: OCM requires cannabis products to pass applicable laboratory testing before sale through licensed adult-use or medical dispensaries.
blocks.sourceTitle: How to Read a New York Cannabis Label

blocks.html: We are not healthcare providers. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before using cannabis, especially if you have a medical condition, are pregnant or nursing, or are taking other medications.
For the medical cannabis program, see the New York State Office of Cannabis Management.
